description: 7DI + 8DO digital I/O with counter/frequency and pulse output. DI at FC02 coil addr 0-6; DO at FC01 coil addr 16-23. FC03 addr 0-13: counter/freq values u32 (7ch). FC03 addr 300: DI word; addr 302: DO word. Modbus enabled when FF parameter bit2=1.

| Advantech ADAM-4150 — 7DI / 8DO Digital I/O Module with Counter/Pulse
| - 7 digital inputs (DI) and 8 digital outputs (DO); each DI configurable as counter/frequency.
| - Modbus RTU enabled when FF parameter bit 2 = 1; default is ADAM ASCII protocol.
| - FC01 counter coils (per DI ch, 4 coils each, ch 0 starts at addr 32):
| Start/Stop(1/0), Clear counter(1), Clear overflow, Latch status.
| - FC03 addr 0-13: Counter/frequency ch 0-6 (u32, 32-bit per channel, 2 regs each; Frequency=ADDR/10 Hz) (R).
| - FC03 addr 14-29: Pulse output L level time ch 0-7 (u32, unit 0.1ms) (R/W).
| - FC03 addr 30-45: Pulse output H level time ch 0-7 (u32, unit 0.1ms) (R/W).
| - FC03 addr 46-61: Set absolute pulse count ch 0-7 (u32; 0=continuous mode) (R/W).
| - FC03 addr 62-77: Set incremental pulse count ch 0-7 (u32) (R/W).
